summary_en: Okinawa Financial Group raised its interim dividend for FY2027 (ending March 2027) by 15 yen to 115 yen per share and revised its full-year dividend forecast upward by 15 yen to 115 yen per share for the year-end dividend, bringing total annual dividend to 230 yen, compared to the previous forecast of 200 yen.
title_en: Notice on Surplus Dividend (Dividend Increase) and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast for FY2027
translation_en_brief:
On 13 November 2026, Okinawa Financial Group's board of directors approved an increase in the interim dividend for FY2027 (year ending 31 March 2027) by 15 yen to 115 yen per share and revised its full-year dividend forecast to raise the year-end dividend by 15 yen to 115 yen per share. The record date for the interim dividend is 30 September 2026, with an effective date of 10 December 2026. Total dividend payout is 2,518 million yen. This brings the total annual dividend for FY2027 to 230 yen per share, an increase of 30 yen from the previously announced forecast of 200 yen (interim 100 yen, year-end 100 yen).

The company's shareholder return policy aims to secure stable earnings and appropriate capital required for regional growth while enhancing investment appeal of its shares. During the second medium-term management plan (FY2025–FY2027), the company commits to stable progressive dividends with a floor of 90 yen per share annually, and to implement flexible shareholder returns in line with profit levels. The increase reflects the company's confidence in earnings performance and commitment to this progressive dividend policy.
